name: Blackedge Ltd
summary: Blackedge Ltd offers a range of financial services to businesses operating within Israel. The company provides capital to residential real estate developers, typically requiring real estate as security, which may involve pledges on assets or project surpluses. It also extends credit secured by pledged securities. Furthermore, Blackedge Ltd accepts other forms of collateral, such as vehicles, personal and owner guarantees, assurances from third parties, and current asset pledges. The firm also facilitates credit arrangements that feature deferred repayment terms for the recipient. Established in 2015, Blackedge Ltd is based in Bnei Brak, Israel, and was previously known as Michman Finance Ltd before adopting its current name in November 2025.
